summary.business_type: Local Service - auto repair & tyre shop (single location, Larvik, Norway)
top_findings: No dedicated service landing pages - services exist only as homepage sections, so nothing can rank for 'EU-kontroll Larvik', 'hjulskift Larvik', etc.
hreflang is invalid: 'no' and 'en' both point to the same URL; English is a client-only ?lang=en toggle with no crawlable URL
Only one schema type (AutoRepair LocalBusiness) - no Service, FAQPage, BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList or AggregateRating despite cached Google reviews being available
Blog posts are thin (~375 words) with inflated readTime, no visible author/date, no internal links to services
Homepage body content (services, pricing, reviews) is client-gated behind a 200ms timer and absent from server HTML
quick_wins: Remove or fix the invalid hreflang tags in app/layout.tsx
Add aggregateRating + @id + E.164 telephone + wider areaServed to LocalBusinessSchema.tsx
Reconcile schema geo coordinates (59.0533,10.0297) with the Maps embed (59.0648,10.0426)
Rewrite blog <title> tags to include the target query and 'Larvik'
Set next.config.js images.minimumCacheTTL to 2678400 and drop the unused Inter font
Make the apex -> www redirect a permanent 301/308 in Vercel domain settings

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Server-rendered title, meta description, canonical and Open Graph on every route
Generated sitemap.xml and correct robots.txt (dekkhotell and api disallowed)
HTTPS with HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy set

findings.title: Homepage body content is client-gated behind a timer
findings.description: app/page.tsx is a client component; Services/Pricing/Reviews render only after setTimeout(200ms) + useDeferredValue at scheduler background priority. Only the hero is in server HTML.
findings.recommendation: Server-render the sections (they take no props, read static JSON) and remove the deferredShowContent gate.

findings.title: Invalid hreflang implementation
findings.description: Live HTML emits rel=alternate hreflang 'no' and 'en' both pointing at https://www.4dekk.no, with no x-default. English has no crawlable URL, no SSR, no distinct canonical.
findings.recommendation: Go Norwegian-only: remove alternates.languages and the hreflang output and stop bundling the en JSON. Or build real /en/ routes with reciprocal hreflang + x-default.

findings.title: Apex to www redirect is 307 temporary
findings.description: https://4dekk.no/ returns 307 Temporary Redirect to https://www.4dekk.no/. Search engines want a permanent redirect to consolidate link equity.
findings.recommendation: Set www as primary with a permanent 301/308 redirect in Vercel domain settings.

findings.title: images.minimumCacheTTL set to 0
findings.description: next.config.js forces the image optimizer to re-optimize on every request - slower delivery and more function cost.
findings.recommendation: Set minimumCacheTTL to 2678400 (31 days) or similar.

findings.title: Partial security headers
findings.description: HSTS, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy are present. X-Content-Type-Options, Permissions-Policy and CSP are missing.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and a Permissions-Policy header at minimum.

findings.title: sitemap lastModified is always today
findings.description: app/sitemap.ts sets lastModified: new Date() on static routes every build, regardless of real change.
findings.recommendation: Use a real per-route content date; align changeFrequency with reality.

findings.title: ESLint disabled during builds
findings.description: next.config.js eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds: true lets regressions (including metadata regressions) ship unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Re-enable, or run eslint in CI as a gate.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: About page names the actual technicians with photos - real E-E-A-T for a workshop
About copy has concrete specifics (10 years, Statens Vegvesen approval, growth story, quality guarantee)
Norwegian, descriptive alt text on key images

findings.title: Blog posts are thin
findings.description: eu-control.json is ~375 words across 13 short paragraphs and 9 headings; stored readTime is 7 minutes (actual ~2). Too thin to rank against NAF, Statens Vegvesen and Mekonomen.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild priority posts to 900-1,500 words of specific, locally framed content; correct readTime.

findings.title: No on-page author, publish date or updated date
findings.description: app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx renders only the h1 and body - no byline, no visible date, no freshness cue on a vehicle-safety topic.
findings.recommendation: Show Publisert/Oppdatert dates and attribute posts to a named technician.

findings.title: No FAQ content anywhere
findings.description: Auto-repair search is dominated by question queries; the site has no FAQ blocks and no FAQPage markup.
findings.recommendation: Add 5-8 real Q&A on the homepage and each service page, marked up as FAQPage.

findings.title: Blog-list image fallback can 404
findings.description: utils/dataLoader.ts maps tyre-category posts to /images/tire-service.webp, which is not present in public/images/.
findings.recommendation: Fix the mapping or add the missing file; ideally give each post a unique image.

findings.title: English content ships with no SEO return
findings.description: Every content JSON carries a full en tree sent to the browser but invisible to search (see hreflang finding).
findings.recommendation: Drop the en trees if going Norwegian-only, or expose them on real /en/ URLs.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique server-rendered title and description per route
One h1 per page; sensible h2 structure on About

findings.title: No dedicated service pages
findings.description: EU-kontroll, etterkontroll, 4-hjulskontroll, AC-service, hjulskift, omlegging, dekkhotell, verkstedarbeid and diagnose exist only as homepage sections. No URL can rank for '<service> Larvik' queries.
findings.recommendation: Create one indexable page per core service with unique title/description, price, inclusions, booking CTA, and Service + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList schema; add to sitemap and internal links.

findings.title: Blog titles don't target the query or location
findings.description: Live title 'EU Kontroll: Hva innebaerer det?' is weaker than its own slug and shows no '| 4Dekk Larvik' suffix.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to e.g. 'EU-kontroll i Larvik: frister, sjekkliste og pris (2026)' and confirm the template suffix renders.

findings.title: No breadcrumbs
findings.description: No BreadcrumbList markup and no UI breadcrumb trail on blog or future service pages.
findings.recommendation: Add both a visible trail and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

findings.title: Weak internal linking
findings.description: Blog posts link only to /contact and /booking. No blog->service, service->blog or blog->blog links.
findings.recommendation: Build a small topic cluster linking seasonal-tyres <-> hjulskift <-> dekkhotell <-> tyre-wear, etc.

findings.title: format-detection telephone=no
findings.description: Disables automatic phone linking on mobile; explicit tel: links exist on the contact page but not verified everywhere.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the phone number is one tap in the header, footer and homepage.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: One valid AutoRepair LocalBusiness block with address, geo, opening hours, sameAs, priceRange, hasMap

findings.title: Only one schema type across the whole site
findings.description: The same AutoRepair block is output on every page, including blog posts. No Service, FAQPage, BlogPosting/Article, BreadcrumbList or AggregateRating.
findings.recommendation: Add Service (service pages), FAQPage (FAQ blocks), BlogPosting (blog posts), BreadcrumbList (blog + service), and aggregateRating on the business.

findings.title: AggregateRating missing despite cached reviews
findings.description: data/cached-reviews.json is fetched and cached server-side but no rating value or count is exposed in schema or on the page.
findings.recommendation: Add aggregateRating + a few review objects; also render the rating visibly to comply with Google policy.

findings.title: Geo coordinates likely wrong
findings.description: Schema geo is 59.0533,10.0297 but the Google Maps embed in the same business.json encodes 59.0648,10.0426 - roughly 1.5 km apart.
findings.recommendation: Verify the real coordinates of Haakon VII's vei 9 and make schema, hasMap and the embed agree.

findings.title: areaServed too narrow
findings.description: areaServed is a single City 'Larvik'.
findings.recommendation: Use an array: Larvik, Stavern, Kvelde, Helgeroa, Tjolling, Sandefjord.

findings.title: telephone not in E.164; NAP inconsistencies
findings.description: telephone is '93 99 55 55'; business.json contact.website is https://4dekk.no while SITE_URL is https://www.4dekk.no.
findings.recommendation: Use +4793995555; pick one canonical NAP string and use it verbatim in schema, footer, contact page and Google Business Profile.

findings.title: No @id / additionalType / offer catalog
findings.description: Business is not a linkable entity node; no tyre-shop additionalType; price list not expressed as offers.
findings.recommendation: Add @id, a tyre-shop additionalType alongside AutoRepair, and hasOfferCatalog from pricing.json.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: WebP images with next/image, priority and fetchPriority on the hero

findings.title: Client-component homepage with deferred sections
findings.description: Below-the-fold sections mount after a 200ms timer, adding JS work and potentially delaying LCP.
findings.recommendation: Server-render the sections and remove the timer gate.

findings.title: Three font families loaded
findings.description: Inter, Roboto and Oswald with multiple weights; body uses Roboto and Inter appears unused though applied to body.
findings.recommendation: Drop Inter; keep Roboto + Oswald.

findings.title: Oversized images
findings.description: car-wash.webp 449 KB, tire-change.webp 354 KB, several IMG_30xx.webp ~300 KB.
findings.recommendation: Re-encode to ~1600px max width, target under 150 KB.

findings.title: Two priority images in the hero
findings.description: hero-image-1.webp plus the logo at quality 95 both marked priority.
findings.recommendation: Keep one true LCP image at priority; drop the logo to quality 80.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: LocalBusiness + sameAs + named team provide a clear entity anchor

findings.title: Thin, non-specific passages
findings.description: Blog paragraphs are short but vague; AI engines quote self-contained chunks with concrete facts.
findings.recommendation: Add exact prices, durations, the EU-kontroll frist rule, and what a Larvik customer should bring.

findings.title: No structured Q&A
findings.description: No FAQPage or Q&A formatting - the format AI Overviews and chat assistants quote most readily.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQ blocks with FAQPage markup on the homepage and service pages.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Optional and ignored by Google, but cheap to provide.
findings.recommendation: Add a short llms.txt pointing at services, prices, hours and contact.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Alt text present on hero, About and blog images

findings.title: Oversized source files
findings.description: Several images 300-450 KB.
findings.recommendation: Re-encode to under 150 KB.

findings.title: Blog posts have no unique og:image
findings.description: Article social/preview cards all fall back to the homepage hero.
findings.recommendation: Give each post its own image and wire it into generateMetadata.

findings.title: Missing tyre-category fallback image
findings.description: utils/dataLoader.ts references /images/tire-service.webp which does not exist.
findings.recommendation: Fix the mapping or add the file.

findings.title: images.minimumCacheTTL 0
findings.description: Optimizer re-processes images every request.
findings.recommendation: Raise to ~31 days.

phases.name: Phase 1: Highest ranking upside
items: Build dedicated service landing pages (/tjenester/eu-kontroll-larvik, hjulskift-larvik, 4-hjulskontroll-larvik, ac-service-larvik, dekkhotell-larvik, bilverksted-larvik) with SSR metadata, price, inclusions, booking CTA and Service + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList schema; add to sitemap
Fix or remove the invalid hreflang tags and decide the English strategy (recommend Norwegian-only)
Server-render the homepage body (remove the client component + 200ms defer gate)
Expand LocalBusinessSchema: aggregateRating + @id + E.164 telephone + wider areaServed + verified geo + hasOfferCatalog
Google Business Profile pass: categories, hours, NAP, photos, review replies, services + prices

phases.name: Phase 2: High-impact improvements
items: Add FAQ content + FAQPage schema on homepage and service pages

Rebuild the 8 blog posts as 900-1,500 word content with dates, bylines, BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList schema, unique og:image and links to service pages (start with eu-control, seasonal-tires, wheel-alignment)
Rewrite blog titles for target query + location
Add breadcrumbs (UI + BreadcrumbList) to blog and service pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Cleanup & polish
items: Make apex -> www a permanent 301/308
Set images.minimumCacheTTL to 2678400 and drop the unused Inter font
Re-encode oversized images to under 150 KB
Fix the tyre-category image fallback in dataLoader.ts
Real per-route lastModified in sitemap.ts; align changeFrequency
Add X-Content-Type-Options and Permissions-Policy headers; re-enable eslint on builds
Optional llms.txt; deploy the two staged blog posts once rewritten

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & iteration
items: Connect Google Search Console (verification files already in public/) and submit sitemap.xml
Run PageSpeed Insights on / and a service page after the server-render change; record LCP/INP/CLS
Re-run this audit after Phase 2 to re-score (target 75+)
Track GBP insights (calls, direction requests, booking clicks) as the primary local KPI
